XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Vehicle equipped with Start&Stop system and electric parking brake

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Battery

  • Fault: Start&Stop system inactive, with failure to automatically engage the electric parking brake

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Malfunctioning battery

• Action: Check that the battery is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, after replacement, no reprogramming of the battery was necessary. To definitively resolve the fault, a road test was carried out.
